features.title: Insert emoji from the existing toolbar
features.description: Add the presentation action that opens the existing editor toolbar’s emoji picker only for editable notes. Add a typed ViewModel insertion method that uses the current focused TextBlock and selection offsets, replaces a valid selection or inserts at its cursor, advances selection after the Unicode sequence, and schedules the existing autosave. If no editable TextBlock is focused, append/focus a paragraph before insertion. Reuse the existing NoteDocument/RichText JSON serialization so Unicode flows through save, reload, sync, sharing, and exporters without a Room/API contract change. Compose owns sheet visibility and TextField focus; it passes events to the ViewModel and never accesses repositories directly. Add the shell bottom sheet, disabled read-only semantics, stable tags, localized resources, and a minimal deterministic catalog dependency seam needed to exercise insertion.
features.user_visible_behavior: An editable note exposes the existing emoji control; it opens a picker and inserts a selected Unicode emoji at the body cursor or into a newly appended paragraph. The same control stays visible but disabled in a read-only note.

evidence.result: Passed 1 production editor-content Compose test on emulator-5554 (API 33): the editable emoji control opened the sheet with Recent selected and preserved the title.
Passed 1 production editor-content Compose test on emulator-5554 (API 33): the read-only control was visible, disabled, localized, and did not open a sheet.
Passed focused ViewModel tests for cursor and range replacement, Unicode selection advancement, and autosave.

features.title: Browse, search, and choose skin-tone variants
features.description: Add an expanded deterministic bundled Unicode emoji catalog behind a domain repository contract and search/category use cases. The data implementation supplies each approved category, at least three additional localized entries per category, localized display name/keywords, Unicode string, stable ID, and optional default plus five skin-tone variants; no network or third-party emoji SDK is introduced. Wire catalog state into the Note Editor picker with a 48dp adaptive lazy grid, localized search/clear controls, selected-category semantics, empty Recent/search surfaces, and a long-press compact skin-tone selector inside the two-fifths-height sheet without a picker title or header close action. When the IME is visible, expand the sheet to the full available height above the keyboard so search results remain visible. Normal tap inserts the default form; a variant selection routes through the US-1 insertion path and keeps the sheet open. Keep filtering/business decisions outside Composables and map domain catalog models into UI models in presentation.
features.user_visible_behavior: Users browse the expanded nine approved categories, search by name/keyword, see a recoverable empty-search state in the two-fifths-height sheet without a picker title or header close action, and choose the exact skin-tone variant they want without closing the picker. While the keyboard is shown, the picker expands above it and keeps the search results visible.

evidence.result: Passed focused JVM catalog/mapper tests: every approved category has its expanded expected count (7–9 entries) and the UI mapper covers the complete bundled catalog; the production picker category test passed within the 8/8 emulator class run.

Final replay passed focused JVM name/keyword search tests and the production picker search, clear, no-result, and compact-sheet recovery flow within the 8/8 emulator class run; the test closes the IME before scrolling the result.

Final replay passed 8/8 production editor-content Compose tests on emulator-5554 (API 33), including expanded category browsing, compact-sheet search recovery, exact medium-tone thumbs-up insertion, and the shipped screen/ViewModel/Recent chain. The JVM mapper test asserted all six exact tone variants.
Passed: US-2 does not own a declared real Android Unicode boundary test; the boundary remains explicitly deferred to US-3.

features.notes: Depends on US-1’s insertion event. It is still a shippable path: all required discovery and skin-tone behavior works, while persisted recents are introduced in US-3.

features.title: Remember selected emoji and validate the completed picker
features.description: Add a domain RecentEmojiRepository contract and DataStore Preferences implementation that records an exact selected Unicode sequence as a bounded MRU list and restores it across app recreation. Inject it through Hilt, connect successful default/variant selections to its update path, and render Recent with the specified empty/fallback state. Complete UI/accessibility/configuration behavior, visual evidence capture, and real Android Unicode-font boundary validation. The instrumented boundary test must run against the shipped picker/text rendering path on an emulator and call Android Paint.hasGlyph for selected catalog sequences; it must fail rather than skip when the expected device/runtime is unavailable. Do not sync, share, export, or add recents to note data unless an emoji was inserted into note content.
features.user_visible_behavior: After an emoji or skin-tone variant is inserted, it appears first in Recent after restarting the app. The two-fifths-height picker without a title or header close action is visually and accessibly verified on a real Android runtime, including the full-height-above-keyboard search state.
